declarations.normative_text: Use model-data-delta-seed names, H:/Expect:/Outcome notes, nested family/arch/train/data/provenance, namespaced metrics/summaries, rank-zero logging and persistent ids. Names and note length are advice.

Never judge success or convergence. Record verdicts from hanig-verified-workflow contracts and hanig-swarm/converge.py predicates. Expect quotes the predeclared predicate. Label post-result checkpoint selection post hoc in card caveats.
Use authorized host capabilities. Callers supply W&B; scripts import only stdlib. Missing access means an incomplete logging check.
Set HANIG_WANDB_LOGGING_DIR to the loaded SKILL.md directory. Keep data/output paths project-relative.
Sanitize every outgoing value recursively, including JSON argv and summary strings. Remove secret-key values. Keep unlabeled credentials out of free text.
Show a logging plan and confirm new shared names. Obtain confirmation before shared run/card edits. Never delete runs or artifact versions as cleanup.
